tools.name: check_ebay_listing
tools.description: Judge whether an eBay listing is a good price: compares its delivered price with what the same model actually sold for recently (great / fair / above typical / overpriced, and % vs the sold median), and lists cheaper listings that ship to the buyer.

tools.name: get_used_price
tools.description: What a used PC part actually sells for on eBay: sold-price median and p25-p75 range (EUR) over the last 30 and 90 days, for one market or all seven pooled.

tools.name: list_tracked_models
tools.description: The PC part models pcprice.watch tracks, with their IDs, optionally filtered by part type.
